label: prf:braiding-induced-ordering
title: Proof of braiding induced ordering
html:
Proof that \prec_c is a well-ordering on B. Let S \subseteq B be non-empty.

(a) Degree is bounded below. Every w \in B has \ell(w) \geq 0. Let d = \min\{\ell(w) : w \in S\}. The set S_d = \{w \in S : \ell(w) = d\} is non-empty.

(b) Finite alphabet at each degree. Each w \in S_d is a word of length d over the finite alphabet \{1, \ldots, n-1\}. There are at most (n-1)^d such words — a finite set. Every finite totally ordered set has a minimum. Let w_0 be the lex-minimum of S_d.

(c) w_0 is the minimum of S. For any w \in S: if \ell(w) > d then w_0 \prec_c w (shorter words first); if \ell(w) = d then w_0 \leq_{\mathrm{lex}} w by construction. \square

Admissibility. The ordering \prec_c is admissible in the sense of (admissible system): left and right multiplication by basis elements preserves the ordering (w \prec_c w' implies u \cdot w \cdot v \prec_c u \cdot w' \cdot v whenever both products are non-zero), because degree-lex is compatible with any associative multiplication whose defining relations (Hecke, Yang–Baxter) have leading terms of bounded degree — the Hecke relation is quadratic.

Two faces of the arrow of time. The braiding c_{V,V} and the Reeb vector field \xi (categorical Reeb) express the same arrow of time from two complementary viewpoints:

  • Categorical arrow (c_{V,V}): which strand crosses over. A positive crossing \sigma_i applies c_{V,V}; a negative crossing \sigma_i^{-1} applies \bar{c}_{V,V} := c_{V,V}^{-1}. The ordering \prec_c is the algebraic encoding: forward time = Gröbner--Shirshov reduction under \prec_c.

  • Geometric arrow (\xi): which direction the Reeb flow runs. The one-parameter subgroup \phi_t^q generated by \xi is the flow of forward time on the state bundle \mathcal{S}. At each Planck step, one application of c_{V,V} advances \phi_t^q by one tick.

Crossing reversal = time reversal. The crossing reversal involution \sigma \colon K \mapsto K^{\sigma} (mirror all crossings) corresponds to switching the braiding: c_{V,V} \leftrightarrow \bar{c}_{V,V}. This flips the ordering \prec_c and reverses the Reeb flow \xi \mapsto -\xi. In the Feynman–Stueckelberg interpretation, an antiparticle (K^{\sigma}) is its particle (K) with time reversed — precisely the opposite braiding. CPT symmetry is the statement that the QOU axioms are invariant under simultaneous c_{V,V} \leftrightarrow \bar{c}_{V,V} (T), K \mapsto K^{\sigma} (C), and \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_{n-i} (P, strand reflection).

Although the underlying mathematical machinery is a standard degree-lexicographic well-foundedness construction, its physical interpretation—formally linking the categorical braid-over-under structure to the macroscopic thermodynamic arrow of time—is a novel conceptual contribution introduced by the Quantum Observable Universe.
